lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੀ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਲ ਰੰਗਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisam bisam bisam hee bhaee hai laal gulaal ra(n)gaarai ||
lines.translation: I am wonder-struck, wonder-struck, wonder-struck and amazed, dyed in the deep crimson color of my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਸੁ ਆਈ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਖਿ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਮੁਸਕਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sa(n)tan ras aaee hai jiu chaakh goo(n)gaa musakaarai ||2||1||20||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Saints savor this sublime essence, like the mute, who tastes the sweet candy, but only smiles. ||2||1||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: na jaanee sa(n)tan prabh bin aan ||
lines.translation: The Saints do not know any other except God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਕਨੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooch neech sabh pekh samaano mukh bakano man maan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They look upon all equally, the high and the low; they speak of Him with their mouths, and honor Him in their minds. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat poor rahe sukh saagar bhai bha(n)jan mere praan ||
lines.translation: He is pervading and permeating each and every heart; He is the Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of fear. He is my praanaa - the Breath of Life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਨਾਸਿਓ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: manahi pragaas bhaio bhram naasio ma(n)tr deeo gur kaan ||1||
lines.translation: My mind was enlightened, and my doubt was dispelled, when the Guru whispered His Mantra into my ears. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਰਹੇ ਕ੍ਰਤਗੵ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਗੵਿਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: karat rahe kratagy karunaa mai a(n)tarajaamee gyiaan ||
lines.translation: He is All-powerful, the Ocean of Mercy, the All-knowing Searcher of Hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਾਂਗਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar naanak jas gaavai maa(n)gan kau har daan ||2||2||21||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day Nanak sings His Praises, and begs for the Gift of the Lord. ||2||2||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਕਈ ਕੇਤੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahan kahaavan kau kaee ketai ||
lines.translation: Many speak and talk about God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਤਤ ਜੋਗ ਕਉ ਬੇਤੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aiso jan biralo hai sevak jo tat jog kau betai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: But one who understands the essence of Yoga - such a humble servant is very rare||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੀ ਨੇਤੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh naahee sabh sukh hee hai re ekai ekee netai ||
lines.translation: He has no pain - he is totally at peace. With his eyes, he sees only the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਭਲਾ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਹਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਸਭ ਜੇਤੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: buraa nahee sabh bhalaa hee hai re haar nahee sabh jetai ||1||
lines.translation: No one seems evil to him - all are good. There is no defeat - he is totally victorious. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਖੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਤੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sog naahee sadaa harakhee hai re chhod naahee kichh letai ||
lines.translation: He is never in sorrow - he is always happy; but he gives this up, and does not take anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਰਮਤੈ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak jan har har har hai kat aavai kat ramatai ||2||3||22||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is himself the Lord, Har, Har; he does not come and go in reincarnation. ||2||3||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਏ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: heee ko preetam bisar na jaai ||
lines.translation: I pray that my heart may never forget my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਗਲਤ ਭਏ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗੇ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਮੋਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man galat bhae tih sa(n)ge mohanee mohi rahee moree maai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My body and mind are blended with Him, but the Enticer, Maya, is enticing me, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਉ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਹਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਤੇਊ ਤੇਊ ਗਹੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਟਕਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai jai pahi kahau brithaa hau apunee teoo teoo gahe rahe atakaai ||
lines.translation: Those unto whom I tell my pain and frustration - they themselves are caught and stuck.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕੀ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗੰਠਿ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anik bhaa(n)t kee ekai jaalee taa kee ga(n)th nahee chhoraai ||1||
lines.translation: In all sorts of ways, Maya has cast the net; the knots cannot be loosened. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਆਇਓ ਸੰਤਨ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phirat phirat naanak daas aaio sa(n)tan hee saranaai ||
lines.translation: Wandering and roaming, slave Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੇ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੀਓ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: kaate agiaan bharam moh maaiaa leeo ka(n)th lagaai ||2||4||23||
lines.translation: The bonds of ignorance, doubt, emotional attachment and the love of Maya have been cut; God hugs me close in His Embrace. ||2||4||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aanad ra(n)g binod hamaarai ||
lines.translation: My home is filled with ecstasy, pleasure and joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamo gaavan naam dhiaavan naam hamaare praan adhaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I sing the Naam, and I meditate on the Naam. The Naam is the Support of my breath of life. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamo giaan naam isanaanaa har naam hamaare kaaraj savaarai ||
lines.translation: The Naam is spiritual wisdom, the Naam is my purifying bath. The Naam resolves all my affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਡਾਈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har naamo sobhaa naam badaaee bhaujal bikham naam har taarai ||1||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glorious grandeur; the Naam is glorious greatness. The Name of the Lord carries me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਾਲ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam padaarath laal amolaa bhaio paraapat gur charanaarai ||
lines.translation: The Unfathomable Treasure, the Priceless Gem - I have received it, through the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਦਰਸਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak prabh bhae kripaalaa magan bhae heearai darasaarai ||2||5||24||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, God has become Merciful; my heart is intoxicated by the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||2||5||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨੇਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan meet suaamee nero ||
lines.translation: My Friend, my Best Friend, my Lord and Master, is near.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਭਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਥੋਰੈ ਕਾਜ ਬੁਰੋ ਕਹ ਫੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekhat sunat sabhan kai sa(n)ge thorai kaaj buro kah phero ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He sees and hears everything; He is with everyone. You are here for such short time - why do you do evil? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੇਤੋ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਕਛੂ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa jeto lapataaio kachhoo nahee naahee kachh tero ||
lines.translation: Except for the Naam, whatever you are involved with is nothing - nothing is yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਵਤ ਸਭ ਪਰਗਟ ਈਹਾ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aagai drisat aavat sabh paragat eehaa mohio bharam a(n)dhero ||1||
lines.translation: Hereafter, everything is revealed to your gaze; but in this world, all are enticed by the darkness of doubt. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਟਕਿਓ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਬਿਸੇਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: atakio sut banitaa sa(n)g maaiaa devanahaar daataar bisero ||
lines.translation: People are caught in Maya, attached to their children and spouses. They have forgotten the Great and Generous Giver.
